profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a software engineer with 5 years experience developing client facing, full stack applications for both banking and media analytics industries. Experience is heavily focused in the JavaScript environment, with deliverables in both React and Angular libraries/framework. Currently working in the React ecosystem using Redux and other 3rd party APIs to deliver solutions for both internal and external clients.

Other experience and certifications include Java, Python, Kubernetes, Nrwl Nx, Material UI, and others. Currently hold AWS Solutions Architect certification.

Outside of work I enjoy adventures of any sort, with travel at the top of the list. I am proficient in German, enjoy cuisine from around the world, and believe learning never stops. If you believe you have nothing more to learn, your life has ceased to be.
